description: We are Team Pinnacle, a team passionate about space exploration, AI/ML, healthcare, and innovation. We aim to develop an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring system to support crew well-being during space missions. We welcome creative thinkers, developers, researchers, and designers who want to solve real-world space challenges. Skills in AI/ML, web development, UI/UX, data science, and research are welcome.
summary:
ORBITA CARE is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and support platform designed to assist astronauts during space missions. It provides an interactive dashboard to visualize important health parameters such as heart rate, oxygen saturation, blood pressure, body temperature, and respiration rate.

The platform features ORBITA AI, an intelligent voice and text-based AI assistant that helps astronauts interact with the system and access health-related guidance. It also includes health status visualization, simulated vital monitoring, countermeasure management, and mission-related health reporting.

Our goal is to simplify access to astronaut health information, support timely health-related decisions, and demonstrate how AI-powered assistance and interactive technologies can contribute to future healthcare systems for space missions.
details:
ORBITA CARE – AI-Powered Astronaut Health Monitoring and Assistance Platform

1. Project Overview

ORBITA CARE is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and assistance platform designed to support crew members during space missions. Space environments expose astronauts to unique challenges, including microgravity, isolation, limited medical resources, and communication delays with Earth. These conditions make continuous health awareness and timely medical guidance essential.

Our project aims to bring astronaut health information, AI assistance, and interactive mission support into one unified platform.

2. How Does It Work?

ORBITA CARE provides an interactive dashboard that displays important health parameters, including heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO₂), blood pressure, body temperature, and respiration rate. The prototype uses simulated health data to demonstrate how astronaut health information can be visualized and monitored.

The platform includes:

  • Health Monitoring Dashboard: Displays vital signs and health status through interactive visualizations.
  • ORBITA AI Assistant: A voice and text-based AI assistant that allows astronauts to interact naturally with the platform and receive AI-generated health-related guidance.
  • Countermeasure Management: Demonstrates the management of health-support activities and countermeasures.
  • Mission Health Reports: Supports the recording and review of mission-related health information.
  • Interactive Interface: Provides a centralized, user-friendly environment for accessing health information and platform features.

3. Benefits and Intended Impact

ORBITA CARE aims to make astronaut health information easier to understand and access. By combining health visualization with AI-powered assistance, it demonstrates a potential approach to supporting health awareness, reducing information complexity, and helping astronauts access relevant guidance during missions.

The concept could be useful in future long-duration space missions, where access to immediate medical support may be limited.

4. Technology and Tools

The prototype is developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and Express.js. Google Gemini API powers the ORBITA AI assistant. WebSocket technology supports real-time AI interaction, while Three.js is used for interactive 3D visual elements. Firebase is included in the backend architecture for data management and persistence.

5. Innovation and Creativity

The key innovation is bringing astronaut health visualization, conversational AI assistance, and mission health support together in one interactive platform. Instead of presenting health information as isolated values, ORBITA CARE demonstrates how astronauts could interact with their health information through a centralized and intelligent interface.

Current Prototype Scope: ORBITA CARE is an independently developed student prototype. Its health data is simulated and it is not connected to real astronaut sensors, spacecraft systems, or NASA infrastructure. It is a demonstration concept and is not a clinically validated medical diagnostic system.
